name: top-students-per-class
title: Top-3 ranking per class (SQLite)
prompt:
Write `query.sql`: a single SQLite `SELECT` over the schema in `school.sql` that returns, for each
class, the students ranked in the top 3 by average grade.
- columns, in order: `class`, `name`, `avg_grade` (rounded to 2 decimals), `rank`
- ties share the same rank and ranks have no gaps (dense ranking); return every student whose rank
  is 1, 2 or 3 (so a class can have more than 3 rows)
- students without any grade are excluded
- order by `class`, then `rank`, then `name`
